description: Upstream Sync — Direct merge to OpenClaw v2026.4.15 (19 releases, 31 breaking changes). Strategy: merge-to-latest then categorized resolution. 5/19 versions already merged incrementally (v2026.3.8→v2026.4.1); remaining absorbed in single v2026.4.15 merge.

strategy_pivot.to: direct merge to latest stable, categorized fix-once resolution
strategy_pivot.reason: Files touched across multiple versions caused redundant conflict resolution at injection points

fusion_guardrails.principle_1: Upstream Leverage: DeXMart MUST NOT duplicate logic that OpenClaw provides. Leverage upstream to ensure automatic changelog adaptation.
fusion_guardrails.principle_2: Exclusive Feature Embedding: DeXMart-exclusive features (confirmed via investigation protocol) MUST be embedded natively in src/ as core modules, not as plugins or secondary citizens.
fusion_guardrails.enforcement: Anti-duplication check during conflict resolution (Phase 2). Compliance audit in Phase 6 (Task 6.6).
